notes.title: Update: Welcome Chinese players!
notes.content:
欢迎您，希望您喜欢这款游戏！

Let's all play together! 
See you in game

notes.title: 1.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: Optimized version for all configs! Go High for 4k assets, or Low if you want to add a player to your game with an older machine!

notes.title: 0.5.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Balance tweaks: an easier time for the thieves at higher player count!
Better volume balance, let's hear Raphael's incredible work on sound design!
Bug fixes

notes.title: Visual Updates
notes.content:
We're constantly working on improving the visuals and the feel of the game, and in today's update we have a couple improvements to share with you all.

1. New dash/catch VFX for the Blackbirds and the Crosbys

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/5b8b3bffed20688a641d1ddb1fed20d5995231b0.gif

2. New VFX and barking SFX for the small dog

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/4ecb15ae976cb268436c220dfddc1517b591d147.gif

3. Improved the VFX for jewels to make them more noticeable once dropped

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/77434279d5c5d02f49e44cd394ca511f94e2e664.png

4. New generated maps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/6c5067b96ad3f3b6c07ebf5b40f0832b9e8a7747.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/a1c168d68b108df2c9d359bf526f23b5ec27f2d1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43063992/3e94cd0dd6d5baa5930c6a0d6d6b41bdbe907dfe.png



As always, don't forget to add A Good Day to your wishlist to be notified as soon as our game is availab le. Thank you for your support!
